name: Scorching Thermal Shock Convergence
primary:
A widening stream (up to 3 blocks wide) hits everyone in front of you; in instant mode it keeps going while held:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire + 1.25 ❤ earth (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• If the target is frozen or brittle: damage 7.25 ❤ thermal
• Light push
• Breaks up to 3 blocks within 0.5 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• If the target is frozen or brittle: damage 7.25 ❤ thermal
• Stone skin (Resistance I) for 7 s
• Slowness I for 5.5 s
